answer: Invite-tree depth tax: each identity is a vertex under one inviter, its bond is 6 POA x 1.25^depth, and an inviter sponsors at most 2 invitees per 30 epochs. An honest user at depth 3 locks 11.72 POA; 1,000 fakes grown as a binary tree reach depth 12, lock about 72,490 POA and need roughly 300 epochs. Buying shallow invitations fails because each seller is capped at 2 per 30 epochs. Validators audit 5% of vertices each epoch for shared devices, anyone can file a whisper report, and a confirmed cluster loses 50% of its bonds. Limit: karst hosting does not lower the bond.
